creator.role: Software developer, product designer and game developer, known online as xTc.
creator.intro: I build products from end to end: I find the idea, design how it should feel, and build it until it works.
creator.what: I work across software, product design and games. I can read, write and debug code on my own, and I use AI coding assistants as tools, not as a replacement for understanding what ships.
creator.interests: Marketplaces and the informal economy, calm and private software, games, creative tools and the systems behind them.
creator.approach: Start from a real problem, design the experience, then build and test until it holds up. AI speeds up drafting and debugging; I review, change and test what it produces.
creator.direction: Growing PitchIT, shipping the projects in progress, and joining teams and clients who want products built with care.
creator.based: Nigeria. Open to relocation and remote work

s1.d: This museum holds the work of David Somadina Obichukwu, known as xTc. Five rooms run in a line. The tour stops at the main pieces; you can leave it at any time and walk on your own.

s2.d: The second room holds work that is out in the world: games live on Roblox and apps you can try. Each installation has a plaque with its status.

s3.d: A team brawler on Roblox, live and still being developed. The plunger is the weapon; knocking rivals off the map is the goal.

s4.d: A published horror memory game on Roblox. A single candle stands for the haunted rooms players have to memorise.

s5.d: A marketplace for every kind of work in Nigeria. The working demo runs in the browser, linked from the details.

s6.d: A private Android journal in testing. Everything stays on the phone: no account, no internet.

s7.d: A book and comics platform in development, with a live preview. Built, partly; the rest is clearly marked as still to come.

s8.d: Room three is for work that is not finished: games and tools in development, prototypes and concepts. Blue labels mark concepts and explorations.

s9.d: A tycoon and heist game in development on Roblox. The images are concept artwork.

s10.d: An AI assisted editing studio. The Python and FFmpeg engine exists; the studio around it is the plan.

s11.d: A real client website, live for a recording studio in Awka. The other frames hold client sites that are built and waiting to launch.

s12.d: Five things David can build for you, each backed by work in this museum.

s13.d: The last room is about the person. This is a real photograph of David.

s14.d: Email, GitHub, X and the CV are all here. Thank you for visiting.
